shorts_extract.hook: Why you still know your 1988 landline by heart—yet forget a saved fact or photographed museum piece in ten minutes.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Sparrow, Liu & Wegner (2011, Science): volunteers recalled 29% of typed facts they thought were erased vs 19% when saved—while remembering which folder held them.
shorts_extract.twist: Linda Henkel (2014) proved quick photos trigger the exact same 'permission to forget'—unless you pause or zoom onto one specific detail.
